title: CAP Code rule 3.1 — Misleading advertising
excerpts: CAP 3.1 Marketing communications must not materially mislead or be likely to do so.
summary: CAP Code rule 3.1 prohibits materially misleading marketing communications. Paraphrase.

title: CAP Code rule 3.7 — substantiation
excerpts: CAP 3.7 Before distributing or submitting a marketing communication for publication, marketers must hold documentary evidence to prove claims that consumers are likely to regard as objective and that are capable of objective substantiation.
summary: CAP requires documentary evidence for objectively substantiable claims before publication. Paraphrase.

title: CAP Code rule 3.4 — price information

summary: CAP identifies material information that may not be omitted from product-price communications. Paraphrase.
